name: scratch-to-reveal

frames.best_why: Half-scratched card keeps the gradient edge while showing the green prize and You win text.

tagline: Scratch the gradient card with the cursor to uncover a prize.
summary: A card covered by a purple-to-peach gradient. Dragging the pointer across it scrapes the layer away, and once enough is cleared the card shakes and reveals the hidden message underneath.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle filled edge to edge with a smooth gradient that runs from lavender on the left through pink to peach on the right. Scraping it away exposes a pale mint-green surface underneath. The revealed layer holds bold green text, You win!, beside a small party-popper emoji.
behaviour: Press and drag the pointer to erase discs of the gradient like a coin on a scratch card; the trail follows the cursor's path. When roughly half the surface is cleared, the overlay wipes away, the card tilts back and forth and snaps straight to show the prize.
demo_content: The hidden prize reads You win! with a party-popper emoji on a mint-green panel.
search_phrases: scratch card to win a prize
peel back cover to see prize
use_when: A promo, coupon, giveaway or onboarding reward where the visitor earns the reveal by scratching it open.
avoid_when: Needs dragging, so it is unusable by keyboard, and the fixed pixel width and height will not adapt to small screens.
customise: Set width, height, the three gradient colours and the scratch threshold via props, plus an onComplete callback; the brush radius and completion shake are fixed in the source.
weight_why: Draws a canvas only while dragging; light otherwise, with a small motion animation on completion.

a11y.note: Scratching needs a pointer drag, so keyboard users cannot reveal the prize, and nothing announces completion to assistive tech.

polish_why: Clean gradient, satisfying scratch and shake; the instant full-clear at the end is a bit abrupt.
title: Scratch To Reveal
